 The Court :
Though the principal prayer in the petition is for the expeditious disposal of an appeal, the appeal had been disposed of prior to the filing o the petition.
Accordingly, a supplementary affidavit has been permitted to be filed by t petitioner to bring on record the events subsequent to the filing of the petition.
T dispute is as to whether an imported consignment of red lentil is fit for human consumption.
The report from the laboratory where the last test was conducted revealed that the uric acid content in the goods is marginally higher at about 103.6 units agains the permissible 100 units.

sentences.text: There is also a dispute between the parties as to whether a further appeal lies or whether the test can be conducted at some other place in an attempt to ascertain the veracity of the previous test.

The respondent authorities have been gracious enough to concede,
without this being treated as a precedent, that the goods may be tested at any other recognised laboratory.

The respondent authorities have suggested that samples may be drawn in the presence of the petitioner's representatives and such samples be sealed in the presence of the petitioner's representatives before being forwarded to any recognised laboratory notified under Section 47 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
The petitioner has indicated that the further tests may be conducted at the Export Inspection Agency Laboratory, Kolkata at 101, Southend Enclave, 1582, Rajdanga Main Road, Kolkata 700 107.

In view of the reasonable stands taken by the parties, the respondent authorities are directed to draw fresh sets of samples from the consignment in the presence of at least two representatives of the petitioner within the next 48 hours upon previous notice.
All fresh samples would be sealed in such a manner that the petitioner or the respondent authorities would not be able to have access to the material without tampering the other's seal.
One of the samples will be sent to the laboratory suggested by the petitioner and the two other samples will be retained by the petitioner and the respondent authorities.
Let the matter appear a fortnight hence for the test results to be indicated in court.
If the goods are found to be in order, the pendency of the petition should not deter the respondent authorities from releasing the goods for home consumption in accordance with law.
Urgent certified website copies of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties subject to compliance with all requisite formalities.

(SANJIB BANERJEE, J.) kc.
